app.name: SafeHands
app.tagline: Clear help for health and safety, even offline.
app.chooseLanguageHint: You can change this later in Settings.
app.machineDraft: Translations are machine-drafted. Please use local clinical and safety advice when available.
app.privacyText: Your entries stay on this device. SafeHands does not send analytics or sell personal information.
app.safetyText: SafeHands is a guide, not a diagnosis. If someone is in immediate danger, call local emergency services.
app.voiceUnavailable: Voice input is not available here. You can always type instead.
app.voiceFallback: This language voice is not available on this device. The text stays on screen and a nearby voice may be used.
app.voiceHint: Voice input is optional. Check the words before submitting.
home.tip: Start with the option that best matches what you need right now.
triage.title: Health check
triage.subtitle: Tell us what is happening. Choose any symptoms and add details in your own words.
triage.describePlaceholder: When did it start? What has changed?
triage.emergencyAdvice: Call emergency services now. Do not drive yourself if you feel unsafe.
triage.urgentAdvice: Contact a health professional today or as soon as you can.
triage.routineAdvice: Arrange a clinic or pharmacy visit. Keep watching for changes.
triage.monitorAdvice: Rest, keep notes, and get help if symptoms worsen or you feel worried.
triage.noSymptoms: Choose at least one symptom or add a description so we can help.
scam.title: Scam Shield
scam.subtitle: Paste or type a message, call script, or offer that feels suspicious.
scam.signalOtp: It asks for a PIN or one-time code
scam.signalPayment: It asks for money or a payment
scam.signalImpersonation: It pretends to be someone I know
scam.highAdvice: Do not reply, click links, send codes, or move money. Contact the person or organization through a trusted number.
scam.mediumAdvice: Pause and verify independently. Never share a PIN, password, or one-time code.
scam.lowAdvice: No common signs were found, but stay careful and verify unexpected requests.
scam.unknownAdvice: Treat it as unverified. Ask a trusted person before taking action.
facilities.title: Find care
facilities.subtitle: A small offline list you can update for your community.
facilities.offlineNote: Locations shown here are saved on this device. Confirm hours before travelling.
facilities.locationStatus: Location is optional. If allowed, the saved list is sorted by approximate distance and nothing is sent anywhere.
